title: Decision tree defines CD8/ARHGEF17 IHC subtypes of BRAF V600E colorectal cancer
summary: Differential expression and a decision tree algorithm selected CD8 and ARHGEF17 from 14 candidate markers to define immunohistochemistry subtypes iBM1 and iBM2 in BRAF V600E-mutant colorectal cancer. Concordance with transcriptomic BM subtypes was 82.69% (training, n=218), 72.22% (validation, institutional n=122) and 83.33% (prospective), with modest kappa 0.44-0.57. The abstract reports iBM1 with poorer survival and greater sensitivity to immune checkpoint inhibitors. The machine learning step is a simple decision tree.
ai_technology: Decision tree algorithm selecting CD8 and ARHGEF17 as IHC classifiers from candidate markers

evidence.tested: Independent institutional cohort (n=122) and a prospective cohort for concordance with transcriptomic subtypes.
evidence.unknown: Clinical benefit of subtype-guided treatment is not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A decision tree algorithm selected the two markers that define the IHC classification.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
